Zeitra Terms of Service

Last updated: 2026-05-04 Version: 1.0

1. Acceptance

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the Zeitra mobile and web application and related services (collectively, the "Service") provided by Tase LLC ("Zeitra," "we," "us," "our"). By creating an account or using the Service you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

2. Eligibility

You must be at least 17 years old to use the Service. By using the Service you represent that you are of legal age and have full authority to enter into these Terms.

Zeitra is intended for healthy adults. If you are pregnant, nursing, have a medical condition, or take medication, consult a qualified healthcare provider before using Zeitra features that involve fasting, dietary changes, or exercise.

3. Medical disclaimer

Zeitra provides general nutrition, exercise, and sleep guidance. It is not medical advice and is not a substitute for professional medical diagnosis or treatment. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay seeking it because of something you read in Zeitra. If you experience chest pain, severe dizziness, sudden weight loss, or any symptom you find concerning, stop using Zeitra and consult a qualified healthcare provider immediately.

  • You are responsible for keeping your account credentials secure.

  • We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or that we believe pose a security or safety risk.

5. Subscriptions, billing, and refunds

5.1 Tiers

Zeitra offers Free, Pro, Premium, and Enterprise tiers. Feature availability per tier is described inside the Service and may change. We will give reasonable notice for any reduction in features available to a paid tier you have already purchased.

5.2 Auto-renewal

Paid subscriptions auto-renew at the same price for the same period (monthly or annual) unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Renewal is charged to the payment method on file (Apple ID, Google account, or your card via Stripe).

5.3 Free trials

If you accept a free trial, your subscription will auto-convert to a paid subscription at the end of the trial unless cancelled before the trial ends. Any unused portion of a trial is forfeited if you upgrade earlier.

5.4 Cancellation

  • iOS: Cancel in your Apple ID Settings → Subscriptions.
  • Android: Cancel in Google Play → Subscriptions.
  • Web: Cancel in Zeitra Settings → Subscription.

Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period; you keep paid features until then.

5.5 Refunds

  • iOS purchases: handled by Apple per their refund policy (reportaproblem.apple.com).
  • Android purchases: handled by Google Play per their refund policy.
  • Web purchases via Stripe: contact billing@zeitra.app within 14 days of purchase for a refund of the most recent billing period if the Service was materially defective.

5.6 Price changes

We may change subscription prices with at least 30 days' notice. Price changes take effect at your next renewal; if you don't accept, cancel before that renewal.

8. AI features

The AI coach, plan generator, and similar features use third-party large language models (currently Anthropic Claude). AI-generated content is probabilistic — it may be incorrect, incomplete, or out of date. Always sanity-check AI-generated nutrition or workout advice before acting on it. Consult a qualified provider for any medical question.

We do not use your prompts to train the AI provider's general models. We may use anonymized, aggregated prompt data to improve our internal rule engines and prompts.

  • We are not responsible for the advice or services provided by the coach.
  • All communication between you and the coach happens inside the Service for safety and abuse prevention.
  • We may verify a coach's credentials but make no guarantee about their qualifications or outcomes.
